zh.title: TAP 航空民營化進入最終階段　Air France-KLM 與 Lufthansa 提交拘束性報價
zh.summary: 葡萄牙國營控股公司 Parpública 確認收到兩份最終提案，競逐 TAP 44.9% 股權。
body: 葡萄牙國營控股公司 Parpública 於 2026 年 9 月 30 日確認，Air France-KLM 與 Deutsche Lufthansa 已就 TAP Air Portugal 再民營化程序提交拘束性報價，標的是公司 44.9% 股權。
Air France-KLM 另行公告，其報價涵蓋 44.9% 至 49.9% 股權，並附上策略與營運計畫。股權上限的差異反映最多 5% 股份預留予員工的安排；葡萄牙政府預計保留 50.1% 控股權。
Parpública 將對報價進行審查並向政府提出報告。各方尚未公布交易價格，也尚未選出得標者，因此本次進展是最終報價收件完成，不代表交易已簽約或交割。

en.title: Air France-KLM and Lufthansa submit final bids for TAP airline stake
en.summary: Portuguese state holding company Parpública confirms two binding proposals for 44.9% of TAP Air Portugal.
body: Portuguese state holding company Parpública confirmed on September 30, 2026 that Air France-KLM and Deutsche Lufthansa had submitted binding proposals in the reprivatization of TAP Air Portugal. The formal process covers a 44.9% stake.

Air France-KLM separately described its offer as covering 44.9% to 49.9% and including a strategic and operational plan. The range reflects a provision reserving up to 5% for employees, while the Portuguese state is expected to retain 50.1%.

Parpública will evaluate the proposals and report to the government. No purchase price or preferred bidder has been announced, so receipt of the final bids is not the same as signing or closing a transaction.

facts.claim: Parpública received two binding proposals for 44.9% of TAP from Air France-KLM and Deutsche Lufthansa.
Air France-KLM described its offer as covering 44.9% to 49.9% and including a strategic and operational plan.
The Portuguese state is expected to retain 50.1%; up to 5% is reserved for employees.
